structure.unit: Actions for the Sale, Lease, Exchange, Redemption and Other Disposition of Lands of Persons Under a Disability

law.text: At any sale under this article neither a fiduciary for a person under a disability, as defined under this article, nor the guardian ad litem shall be a purchaser directly or indirectly; provided, however, such fiduciary may be a purchaser if the court finds that such a purchase by the fiduciary is in the best interests of the person under a disability.
